EDEN AppDev Active Canon v1.8 — CLEANUP
This package reconciles the active rules after the September 24 cleanup decisions.

Separation:
ACTIVE_CANON/AppDevRules.txt — universal development rules; no entity catalogue.
ACTIVE_CANON/edenOSrules.txt — universal edenOS rules; no entity catalogue.
REGISTRY/GrandMasterRegister_CONTRACT.txt — authoritative registry role; user-opt-in integration.
PROFILES/EDEN_Deployment_Audience_Profiles.txt — Private/Family/Friends/Public policy.
PROFILES/PRIVATE_LUCAS_Profile.txt — Lucas-specific Private defaults.
CONTRACTS/CapabilityContracts.txt — compact shared-capability contract rules.
PROVENANCE/Canon_Supersession_Ledger.txt — superseded/experimental/unresolved history.
PRIVATE_TXT/ — human-readable copies/index for Lucas Private build.

This is a canon cleanup, not an App catalogue reconstruction. The complete GrandMasterRegister entity dataset must be recovered/consolidated separately from existing project sources without inventing missing identities.
